main_text.p: aut instar aquarum lentarum effluere notantur, & congelantur.
·X V.· Duratio mineralium etsi diu-turna est, tamen terminos suos habet, quos non transit, etiamsi ab externa vio-lentia libera sint.
§. Hæc enim naturæ lex, ut quæ-cunque genita sunt, corruptioni rursus subjiciantur, & perpetuo durare ne-queant.

page.notes: Printed page number "160" and running head "INSTITUTIONUM" read from the head of the page. The word "LIBER" near the lower middle is a printed division word, set as a line of text. Faint show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed.
